title: 집안일: 빨래하고, 설거지하고, 청소기 돌리기
objective: By the end, you can name common household chores in Korean and use each word with the right verb in a short sentence, such as 빨래를 널다 or 청소기를 돌리다.
summary: Learn ten everyday words for doing laundry, washing dishes, cleaning, and taking out the trash at home.

task.title: Use the housework words
task.line: Choose, write, or arrange the Korean words to complete each item.

words.meaning: laundry; washing clothes (빨래하다: to do the laundry)
words.exampleMeaning: The weather was nice, so I did the laundry today.

words.meaning: washing machine (세탁기를 돌리다: to run the washing machine)
words.example: 세탁기 소리가 커서 밤에는 안 돌려요.
words.exampleMeaning: The washing machine is loud, so I don't run it at night.

words.meaning: to hang (wet laundry) out to dry
words.example: 비가 와서 빨래를 방 안에 널었어요.
words.exampleMeaning: It was raining, so I hung the laundry inside the room.

words.example: 마른 옷은 개서 서랍에 넣어 주세요.
words.exampleMeaning: Please fold the dry clothes and put them in the drawer.

words.meaning: washing the dishes (설거지하다: to do the dishes)
words.example: 밥은 내가 했으니까 설거지는 네가 해.
words.exampleMeaning: I cooked, so you do the dishes.
Vacuuming late at night is noisy.
A lot of dust has built up on the desk.

words.meaning: to wipe; to clean a surface with a cloth
words.exampleMeaning: I spilled water, so I wiped the floor.

words.meaning: to tidy up; to put things in order
words.example: 손님이 오기 전에 거실을 정리해야 해요.
words.exampleMeaning: I need to tidy up the living room before the guests come.

words.meaning: trash; garbage (쓰레기를 버리다: to take out / throw away the trash)
words.example: 나가는 길에 쓰레기 좀 버려 줄래요?
words.exampleMeaning: Could you take out the trash on your way out?

exercises: Choose the right word (빨래 / 설거지 / 청소기): 그릇이 너무 많아서 ____하는 데 30분 걸렸어요.
Choose 널다, 개다, or 닦다 and write it in the -았/었어요 form: ① 젖은 수건을 베란다에 ____. ② 안경이 더러워서 천으로 ____. ③ 마른 티셔츠를 ____.
Which machine do you need? Answer with one Korean word: ① 바지랑 양말을 빨고 싶어요. ② 카펫에 과자 부스러기가 많아요.
Circle the word that goes with each phrase: ① 쓰레기를 (버려요 / 널어요) ② 청소기를 (돌려요 / 개요) ③ 창가에 먼지가 (쌓였어요 / 널었어요)
Put the words in order to make a sentence: 청소기를 / 먼저 / 정리하고 / 방을 / 돌려요
Read the dialogue. What is Minsu doing now, and what will he do next? 엄마: 민수야, 쓰레기 좀 버려 줘. / 민수: 지금 빨래 개고 있어요. 끝나고 버릴게요.
answers: ① 널었어요 ② 닦았어요 ③ 갰어요 (개었어요)
① 버려요 ② 돌려요 ③ 쌓였어요
방을 먼저 정리하고 청소기를 돌려요. (먼저 방을 정리하고 청소기를 돌려요.)
He is folding the laundry now. After that, he will take out the trash.
